meta.title: Team | LipoNexus
meta.description: Meet the LipoNexus leadership team — executives and co-founders with expertise from Quest Diagnostics, Dexcom, Pfizer, and UC San Diego, leaders in Lipidomics and Fatty Liver Disease.

hero.headline: Executive Team with Scientific, Medical & Industry Expertise
hero.body: LipoNexus brings together world-class scientists, clinicians, and industry executives united by a common goal: transforming how Fatty Liver Disease is detected and managed. Co-founded by UC San Diego professors and physicians who are recognized leaders in Lipidomics and Hepatology.

members.name: Andrew Dennis, MBA
members.title: Chief Executive Officer
members.bio: Formerly led Growth Programs at Quest Diagnostics, Business Development at Reveal Biosciences (CellCarta), and Sensor Chemistry R&D at Dexcom. Brings deep commercialization and clinical laboratory diagnostics experience.

members.name: Michael Krupp, PhD
members.title: VP Business Development
members.bio: Founder & CEO of Neurgain Technologies. Formerly CBO at Chugai Pharma USA and Director of Licensing and Development at Pfizer. Brings extensive biopharma partnering and business development expertise.

members.name: Edward A. Dennis, PhD
members.title: Co-Founder
members.bio: Distinguished Professor of Chemistry, Biochemistry, and Pharmacology at UC San Diego. Founder of LIPID Metabolites And Pathways Strategy (LIPID MAPS®). A founder of the field of lipidomics and a leader in inflammation, lipid metabolism, and metabolic diseases.

members.name: Rohit Loomba, MD, MHSc
members.title: Co-Founder
members.bio: Professor and Chief, Division of Gastroenterology and Hepatology, Department of Medicine, UC San Diego Health Sciences. Founding Director, MASLD Research Center, UC San Diego. Key Opinion Leader in liver disease and MASH, working with all leading MASH therapeutics companies and clinical practice guidelines boards.

members.name: Tim Scott, JD
members.title: Advisor
members.bio: CEO/President of Biocom California. Founder/President of Pharmatek (Catalent). Founder and CEO of TEGA Therapeutics. Brings extensive life sciences industry and commercialization leadership.

members.name: Claire Weston, PhD
members.title: Advisor
members.bio: Founder and CEO of Tactus AI. Founder and CEO of Reveal Biosciences (CellCarta). Brings deep expertise in AI-driven diagnostics and biotech company building.

members.name: Arun Sanyal, MD
members.title: Advisor
members.bio: Professor of Medicine, Physiology, and Molecular Pathology in the Division of Gastroenterology at Virginia Commonwealth University (VCU) Medical Center. Director of the Stravitz-Sanyal Institute for Liver Disease and Metabolic Health. Recognized global Key Opinion Leader active in hepatology guideline updates.
